title: An Efficient Long-Context Ranking Architecture With Calibrated LLM Distillation: Application to Person–Job Fit

bias_targets.methodology: Splitting the test set based on the gender declared by freelancers and computing the difference in recall metrics between women and men to assess potential discrimination.

Evaluating and comparing the model's robustness, relevancy, ranking, and calibration metrics across different project brief languages (French, English, Spanish, German, and Dutch) to assess performance disparities.
